sections.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing (Micron Technology)
sections.description: Micron Technology (Boise HQ) — the only large US DRAM and NAND flash memory manufacturer, competing with Samsung and SK Hynix globally.

blocks.heading: DRAM process control AI
paragraphs: ML for Micron's DRAM manufacturing process monitoring — statistical process control augmented with ML for detecting process drift at critical lithography, etch, and deposition steps before yield impacts accumulate.

blocks.heading: Memory yield optimization
paragraphs: ML connecting process parameters, test data, and final yield outcomes for Micron's Boise DRAM fabs — identifying yield-limiting factors in the complex multi-step DRAM manufacturing process.

blocks.heading: Memory test analytics
paragraphs: ML for DRAM and NAND parametric test outcome prediction — reducing test time and improving early screening of potentially defective devices before final test.

sections.title: Healthcare (St. Luke's and Saint Alphonsus)
sections.description: St. Luke's Health System (Boise HQ, 8 hospitals across Idaho and eastern Oregon) and Saint Alphonsus Regional Medical Center (Boise, Trinity Health network).

blocks.heading: Idaho Medicaid analytics
paragraphs: ML for the managed care organizations serving Idaho's Medicaid program — population health prediction, chronic disease management, and social determinants analytics for Idaho's geographically dispersed Medicaid population.

blocks.heading: Rural telehealth analytics
paragraphs: ML for St. Luke's large rural health outreach — predicting which rural Idaho patients are at highest risk for preventable admissions, enabling proactive telehealth outreach that reduces the access barriers of Idaho's large rural geography.

blocks.heading: HIPAA-compliant clinical AI
paragraphs: Standard clinical AI deployment for Idaho's major health systems.

sections.title: Agriculture (Idaho's World-Class Produce)
sections.description: Idaho is the world's premier potato-growing state and a major dairy and trout producer.

blocks.heading: Potato yield and quality prediction
paragraphs: ML for Idaho's potato growers — soil condition, irrigation, and weather analytics for yield and quality prediction in the Snake River Plain's volcanic soil growing environment.

blocks.heading: Dairy operations analytics
paragraphs: ML for Idaho's large dairy operations — milk production prediction, herd health monitoring, and feed optimization analytics.

blocks.heading: Agricultural supply chain AI
paragraphs: Supply chain analytics for the potato processors (Lamb Weston in Eagle ID, J.R. Simplot in Boise) serving McDonald's and the fast food french fry market.

sections.title: Investment Analytics (Clearwater Analytics)
sections.description: Clearwater Analytics (Boise HQ, NYSE: CWAN) — cloud-based investment accounting and analytics SaaS for insurance companies and institutional investors managing $7+ trillion in assets.

blocks.heading: Investment analytics platform AI
paragraphs: ML features for Clearwater's insurance and institutional investment analytics platform — risk analytics, performance attribution, and regulatory reporting ML for Clearwater's large insurance company customer base.

blocks.heading: Data quality and reconciliation AI
paragraphs: ML for Clearwater's data quality management — detecting errors and anomalies in the investment data flows from custodians, managers, and counterparties that Clearwater aggregates for its customers.

sections.title: Boise's technology transformation
sections.description: Boise's technology market has grown significantly from its Micron-and-HP roots.

blocks.heading: Remote work migration boom
paragraphs: Boise experienced one of the US's most dramatic remote work migration booms — California technology workers' migration to Boise during and after COVID-19 has created a more technology-sophisticated local market and a larger pool of technology talent than Boise's historical economy would have produced. The Treasure Valley's population has grown at rates that regularly place it among the fastest-growing US metro areas.

blocks.heading: Micron's US semiconductor renaissance
paragraphs: Micron's investment in US semiconductor manufacturing — driven by the CHIPS and Science Act and geopolitical semiconductor supply chain concerns — has accelerated Micron's Boise manufacturing investment. This investment creates both direct manufacturing AI demand and an ecosystem of Micron suppliers and contractors with technology investment capacity.

blocks.heading: Clearwater Analytics' growth
paragraphs: Clearwater Analytics' growth from Boise to a Nasdaq-listed company managing analytics for $7+ trillion in institutional assets has demonstrated that technology companies of genuine scale can be built in Boise — and has created an anchor analytics company that is attracting financial technology talent to the Treasure Valley.
